releaseNotes: Adds a guarded live single-item transfer path and refreshes the uniquely matched open locker grid through Breathedge's D_UpdateInventory_Event. The v75 saved-change path remains as fallback. Update both PCs and test sequential one-Wire deposit and withdrawal with both locker UIs open. Multi-item and simultaneous access remain unsupported; live two-PC UI behavior is not yet verified.
